victoryLines.text: The attackers flee the castle! You have routed them, Commander!

victoryLines.speaker: Ally Lord
victoryLines.text: Indeed. The situation was dire until your timely arrival. My thanks to you, Sir Varius.

victoryLines.speaker: Imperial Lord
victoryLines.text: It did not sit well with my brother Martin when our father's lands passed to me, nor my continued support of the Empire.

victoryLines.speaker: Imperial Lord

lines.speaker: Imperial Lord
lines.text: And with these lands you would war against the Empire. Father would not have wished it, and so our lands came to me.

lines.speaker: Enemy Lord

levels.name: Aguilleon 1
levels.objectiveText: Conquer the Aguilleon gate and gain entrance to the high pass.

factions.name: Player

victoryLines.speaker: The Emperor
victoryLines.text: Well done, Sir Varius. Lead the vanguard into the pass and the legion shall follow for the siege upon El Acclazar.

defeatLines.speaker: War Advisor
defeatLines.text: With the losses you have suffered, we must retreat and assemble a stronger force.

lines.speaker: Field Officer
lines.text: Your army has been well provisioned by the Carrone camp and awaits your marching orders.

lines.speaker: Field Officer
lines.text: And the legion's general has arrived to discuss a battle strategy for conquering the pass.

lines.speaker: Herald
lines.text: You will no doubt recall Lord Anston, Viscount of Carrone and General of the Third Legion.

lines.speaker: The Emperor
lines.text: Sir Varius. I knew your worth would be recognized by the Emperor. It is good to see you again after so long.

lines.speaker: Sir Anston
lines.text: If it were only under better circumstances. This campaign into Aguilleon will be hard fought and cost us many brave soldiers before it is done.

lines.speaker: Sir Anston
lines.text: The legion will assist with war engines for the assault on the lower gate here, but their transport through the high pass will be most difficult.

lines.speaker: Sir Anston
lines.text: It will fall upon your vanguard to clear the pass to El Acclazar if we are to support your siege of that great fortress.

lines.speaker: Sir Anston
lines.text: I will make ready the legion and await your advance. May the Gods smile upon us, Sir Varius.

lines.speaker: Sir Anston
lines.text: Conquer the gate as quickly as possible. The longer we fight here the more of their damned griffon riders will descend upon us.

lines.text: The Third Legion's war engines will take time to gain the summit of the pass.

lines.speaker: Sir Anston
lines.text: If we should come under attack now, they would be especially vulnerable.

lines.speaker: Sir Anston
lines.text: It will be up to your vanguard to shield them from danger. If too many war engines are lost, you will not have the strength to conquer El Acclazar.

lines.speaker: War Advisor

lines.speaker: War Advisor

factions.name: Player

victoryLines.speaker: Herald
victoryLines.text: El Acclazar has fallen! You have conquered where all others have failed! It is an honor to serve in your army, Commander.

victoryLines.speaker: The Emperor
victoryLines.text: The Carrone Empire owes you a great debt, Sir Varius. I shall see to it personally that the Emperor knows of your courage and prowess this day.

defeatLines.speaker: War Advisor

victoryLines.speaker: Field Officer

lines.speaker: Field Officer
lines.text: This village is too close to our coastal shipyards and would be a natural launching point for Hunewold raids.

lines.speaker: Field Officer
lines.text: For this reason, this location also becomes ideal for the site of your fortress, Sir Varius.

lines.speaker: Field Officer
lines.text: The village tribe has gathered to repel us, rather than retreating into the wood as is their usual war strategy. Something has inspired them, even if their chance of victory is hopeless.

lines.speaker: Sergeant
lines.text: Spirits of their ancestors rise up to fight alongside their shamans!

lines.speaker: Sergeant
lines.text: It is as if we battle against armies of present and past!

victoryLines.speaker: Field Officer
victoryLines.text: Your fortress is strong, Commander. Within the week, when the moat is complete and inner ring of towers raised, this position of strength will safeguard our coastal settlements from any harm.

lines.speaker: Field Officer
lines.text: Hunewold tribesmen approach from all sides, Sir Varius.

lines.speaker: Field Officer
lines.text: I have inspected the perimeter and found the towers and ramparts secure, though the moat is still incomplete for our high ground defense.

lines.speaker: Field Officer
lines.text: We should be able to repel any assault this rabble can muster.

lines.speaker: Field Officer
lines.text: Sir Varius. It appears that three different tribes are part of this attack.

lines.speaker: Field Officer
lines.text: Their advance is disorganized and they have little knowledge of formation, but the fact that they are cooperating is cause for concern.

lines.speaker: Herald
lines.text: The tribesmen host has broken and their survivors scatter into the wood to carry the tune of their defeat.

lines.speaker: Field Officer
lines.text: Your fortress is strong, Commander. Within the week, when the moat is complete and inner ring of towers raised, this position of strength will safeguard our coastal settlements from any harm.

victoryLines.speaker: Sergeant
victoryLines.text: Victory! VICTORY! Hail Varius, blessed be his name!

victoryLines.speaker: Herald
victoryLines.text: Sir Varius will be recorded in imperial history as the general that stood against the combined might of the Hunewold and tore it asunder.

victoryLines.speaker: Herald
victoryLines.text: This is a shining day for you and the Empire.

lines.speaker: Field Officer
lines.text: Sir Varius, I come with word just delivered from our far watch patrol.

lines.speaker: Field Officer
lines.text: A horde of Hunewold tribesmen, of a size greater than any met during the first conquest, has emerged from the east.

lines.speaker: Field Officer
lines.text: The tribes have united under a single war leader, Armagni, with the sole purpose of raiding and burning all imperial settlements in the Hunewold.

lines.speaker: Field Officer
lines.text: Their first hammer stroke will fall upon our fortress here. It will be up to us to turn the tide or be swept away under their onslaught.

lines.speaker: Sergeant
lines.text: By the gods! The very trees sway with the stamp of their approach!

lines.speaker: Field Officer
lines.text: My apologies, my lord. The men are ready and the fortress sound. Lead us through this terror to victory and the Hunewold is the Empire's once more.

lines.speaker: Sergeant
lines.text: Victory! VICTORY! Hail Varius, blessed be his name!

lines.speaker: Herald
lines.text: Sir Varius will be recorded in imperial history as the general that stood against the combined might of the Hunewold and tore it asunder.

lines.speaker: Herald
lines.text: This is a shining day for you and the Empire.

victoryLines.speaker: Field Officer
victoryLines.text: Setting fire to these huts will draw their scouts to investigate.

victoryLines.speaker: Field Officer
victoryLines.text: Word will spread among their tribes that Carrone has returned to the Rukiev. We should expect the Horselords' reprisal to be swift and fierce.

lines.speaker: Herald
lines.text: You have the Emperor's trust and favor, Sir Varius.

lines.speaker: Field Officer
lines.text: The honor of leading the army that will first face the Horselords has been given to you.

lines.speaker: Field Officer
lines.text: As we march east and draw their fury upon us, Duke Stokeshire and Viscount Anston will land ships upon the Mirror Sea coast and retake our first settlement.

lines.speaker: Field Officer
lines.text: Attacking this small encampment will be the spark that ignites the Horselords' ire. We must keep them blind to our fleet if they are to land safely.

lines.speaker: Field Officer
lines.text: Setting fire to these huts will draw their scouts to investigate.

lines.speaker: Field Officer
lines.text: Word will spread among their tribes that Carrone has returned to the Rukiev. We should expect the Horselords' reprisal to be swift and fierce.

victoryLines.speaker: Field Officer
victoryLines.text: The size of their force was smaller than expected. This could not have been their full strength.

victoryLines.speaker: Field Officer
victoryLines.text: Let us hope this was only a feint to test us. If their main host is not upon the plain when our fleet lands, our allies will be lost.

lines.speaker: Field Officer
lines.text: Two days since our attack upon their camp and still no counter from the Horselords.

lines.speaker: Field Officer
lines.text: Their attention must be fixed upon us for our landing at the Mirror Sea to be successful.

lines.speaker: Sergeant
lines.text: Sir Varius! Horselords riding hard from the west!

lines.speaker: Sergeant
lines.text: REGROUP! They seek to strike at the rear flanks of our column!

lines.speaker: Field Officer
lines.text: The size of their force was smaller than expected. This could not have been their full strength.

lines.speaker: Field Officer
lines.text: Let us hope this was only a feint to test us. If their main host is not upon the plain when our fleet lands, our allies will be lost.

victoryLines.speaker: Herald
victoryLines.text: My Lord, your Grace, when no word arrived of your landing we feared the worst.

victoryLines.speaker: Sir Anston
victoryLines.text: Our apologies to you, Sir Varius. Your attacks were successful in luring the Horselord host away from the Mirror Sea, but we were delayed in crossing Mare Nostra.

victoryLines.speaker: Imperial Lord
victoryLines.text: Aye, strange storm winds from the east nearly closed the narrows to us. Only a third of the fleet actually made the landing, we do not yet know the full extent of our losses.

victoryLines.speaker: Sir Anston
victoryLines.text: There will be a time to mourn the dead. For now, let us celebrate the living.

victoryLines.speaker: The Emperor
victoryLines.text: Come, friends. Let us find a skin of wine to share while Sir Varius tells us of his campaign across the Rukiev!

lines.speaker: Field Officer
lines.text: The Horselords have arrived in strength, Sir Varius. Our scouts estimate they have nearly twice our number.

lines.speaker: Field Officer
lines.text: With still no messenger from our allies, we must assume that the fleet has been lost.

lines.speaker: Field Officer
lines.text: Our few against their many, we shall give them such a battle that will not long be forgotten.

lines.speaker: Sergeant
lines.text: We fight for Sir Varius! We fight for the Emperor! WE FIGHT FOR CARRONE!

lines.speaker: Herald
lines.text: Warhorns! Warhorns from the east!

lines.speaker: War Advisor
lines.text: By the grace of the Emperor...!

lines.speaker: Loyal Lord
lines.text: And for the glory of Carrone!

lines.speaker: Herald
lines.text: My Lord, your Grace, when no word arrived of your landing we feared the worst.

lines.speaker: Sir Anston
lines.text: Our apologies to you, Sir Varius. Your attacks were successful in luring the Horselord host away from the Mirror Sea, but we were delayed in crossing Mare Nostra.

lines.speaker: Imperial Lord
lines.text: Aye, strange storm winds from the east nearly closed the narrows to us. Only a third of the fleet actually made the landing, we do not yet know the full extent of our losses.

lines.speaker: Sir Anston
lines.text: There will be a time to mourn the dead. For now, let us celebrate the living.

lines.speaker: The Emperor
lines.text: Come, friends. Let us find a skin of wine to share while Sir Varius tells us of his campaign across the Rukiev!

victoryLines.speaker: The Emperor
victoryLines.text: I take pride knowing that I trained you as squire. Your skill in battle will return the Empire to its former glory!

defeatLines.speaker: The Emperor
defeatLines.text: You are a worthy adversary, Sir Varius. Any further assistance in training the Legion would be met with my deepest gratitude.

lines.speaker: The Emperor
lines.text: Greetings, Sir Varius. It is good to see you safe and well through the Merovin Rebellion.

lines.speaker: The Emperor
lines.text: While you wage war to recover the lost kingdoms of the Empire, I have been given the honor of rebuilding the Third Carrone Legion.

lines.speaker: The Emperor
lines.text: Your assistance in training the recruits is greatly appreciated. Grant me but a moment to address the men before we begin.

lines.speaker: War Advisor
lines.text: Men of Carrone! Today you will learn to fight as soldiers of the Third Legion!

lines.speaker: War Advisor
lines.text: The path to victory lies in gaining advantage over your enemy. Each army's strength has its counter strategy!

lines.speaker: War Advisor
lines.text: A large force of foot troops will be powerful, but they are slow to maneuver and vulnerable to ranged attack! Cavalry will be quick and devastating in the charge, but will break upon a reinforced pikewall!

lines.speaker: War Advisor
lines.text: In facing a reinforced position, such as this fortress, war engines are critical in bringing down the walls or gate!

lines.speaker: War Advisor
lines.text: The defender will likely be in position to strike first, so a tight formation of armored soldiers will be needed to shield your advancing army!

lines.speaker: The Emperor
lines.text: Sir Varius, I will take command of the defending force. Rest assured my crossbowmen will give your army a warm welcome.

lines.speaker: The Emperor
lines.text: I take pride knowing that I trained you as squire. Your skill in battle will return the Empire to its former glory!

lines.speaker: The Emperor
lines.text: You are a worthy adversary, Sir Varius. Any further assistance in training the Legion would be met with my deepest gratitude.

lines.text: Form ranks for defense! Flee east if you can!

lines.speaker: Sergeant
lines.text: Our first casualty! We must break through or finish the enemy before our numbers diminish!

lines.speaker: Sergeant

lines.speaker: Sergeant

victoryLines.speaker: Sir Anston
victoryLines.text: Perhaps your days as a squire have not yet prepared you for war. I shall have to think on this.

defeatLines.speaker: Sir Anston
defeatLines.text: Perhaps your days as a squire have not yet prepared you for war. I shall have to think on this.

lines.speaker: Sir Anston
lines.text: Squire Varius, assemble the soldiers onto the green outside the castle. I would address them before we march.

lines.speaker: Sir Anston
lines.text: The soldiers must be assembled within the green square before we can march.

lines.speaker: Sir Anston
lines.text: Very good, Varius.

lines.speaker: War Advisor
lines.text: Men of Carrone! His Grace, Duke Pellus, has gathered support from the noble houses of Merovin to rise up against our Emperor.

lines.speaker: War Advisor
lines.text: His army marches even now toward Carrone and will arrive within the week!

lines.speaker: War Advisor
lines.text: The Emperor has called for all those still loyal to the Empire to come to his aid!

lines.speaker: War Advisor
lines.text: What say you? Do we march to the imperial city and defend our Emperor?

lines.speaker: Sergeant
lines.text: Yes! YES! By the grace of the Emperor and for the glory of Carrone!

lines.speaker: Sir Anston
lines.text: Perhaps your days as a squire have not yet prepared you for war. I shall have to think on this.

victoryLines.text: As you command, Sir.

victoryLines.speaker: Sir Anston
victoryLines.text: Varius, rest well tonight. Eat, drink, find warm company, for tomorrow we march to war.

lines.speaker: Sir Anston
lines.text: We shall reach the imperial city by tomorrow, squire. Tonight we will treat the men to meat and wine in the village ahead.

lines.speaker: Sir Anston
lines.text: What is this now? Looters fleeing the coming war?

lines.speaker: War Advisor

victoryLines.speaker: Sir Anston
victoryLines.text: Perhaps your days as a squire have not yet prepared you for war. I shall have to think on this.

defeatLines.speaker: Sir Anston
defeatLines.text: You have quality within you. I've always seen that. Fight well today and a knighthood shall be yours.

lines.speaker: Sir Anston
lines.text: Wake up, squire. The day is upon us and the men need to be assembled.

lines.speaker: Sir Anston
lines.text: A levy of militia has formed from the local folk. They wish to march with us to fight for Carrone. I have agreed to their request.

lines.speaker: Sir Anston
lines.text: Deploy the men in formation in the field outside the village. We march to our Emperor's call.

lines.speaker: Sir Anston
lines.text: The men are ready then? Good.

lines.speaker: Sir Anston
lines.text: We march west along the road to the imperial city.

lines.speaker: Sir Anston
lines.text: Perhaps your days as a squire have not yet prepared you for war. I shall have to think on this.

lines.speaker: Sir Anston
lines.text: You have quality within you. I've always seen that. Fight well today and a knighthood shall be yours.

victoryLines.speaker: Sir Anston
victoryLines.text: Your valor today does you credit Varius, as does the years of your service to my family.

victoryLines.speaker: The Emperor
victoryLines.text: Kneel, and accept the honor and duty of knighthood.

victoryLines.speaker: The Emperor
victoryLines.text: I free you from my service and charge you to defend the Empire against all who oppose it. Arise, Sir Varius.

victoryLines.speaker: Sir Anston
victoryLines.text: My orders are to guard this vale, but I believe the worst has passed.

victoryLines.speaker: Sir Anston
victoryLines.text: Take what men you can gather and go to support our main force, by the grace of the Emperor.

lines.speaker: Sir Anston
lines.text: Our Emperor is young, but cautious.

lines.speaker: Sir Anston
lines.text: He leaves no path to Carrone unguarded against Duke Pellus, even this small vale west of his main force.

lines.speaker: Sir Anston
lines.text: We may not see much in the way of battle today squire, but stay close and I will teach you the way of war.

lines.speaker: Sir Anston
lines.text: We have crossbowmen and catapults well placed on the ridge. We should let the enemy come to us while we rain rock and arrow down upon their heads.

lines.speaker: War Advisor
lines.text: As their army closes with ours, try to position the cavalry in line for a charge. With our foot soldiers... ATTACK AT WILL!

lines.speaker: War Advisor
lines.text: Flank and surround the enemy units to deliver more damage with each melee attack! Break holes in their line to weaken their formation defense!

lines.speaker: War Advisor
lines.text: Sweep around their position! Close in and finish them!
